```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go

def embed(A, eigenvalue):

    # Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
    eigvals, eigvecs = np.linalg.eigh(A)

    #print("Eigenvalues:")
    #print(np.round(eigvals, 4))

    # select eigenspace
    idx = np.argmin(np.abs(eigvals - eigenvalue))
    eigenvalue = eigvals[idx]

    coords = eigvecs[:, np.isclose(eigvals, eigenvalue)]

    print(f"\nEigenvectors for λ = {eigenvalue}:")
    for i, vec in enumerate(coords.T):
        print(f"\nEigenvector {i+1}:")
        print(np.round(vec, 4))

    # -------------------------
    # PCA if dimension > 3
    # -------------------------
    if coords.shape[1] > 3:
        print("\nApplying PCA (dim > 3 → reducing to 3D)")

        X = coords

        # center
        X = X - np.mean(X, axis=0)

        # covariance
        C = X.T @ X

        # eigen-decomposition of covariance (PCA)
        pca_vals, pca_vecs = np.linalg.eigh(C)

        # sort descending
        idx = np.argsort(pca_vals)[::-1]
        pca_vecs = pca_vecs[:, idx]

        # project to top 3 components
        coords = X @ pca_vecs[:, :3]

    else:
    # if dim < 3, pad with zeros
        coords = coords[:, :coords.shape[1]]

        if coords.shape[1] == 1:
            coords = np.hstack([coords, np.zeros((coords.shape[0], 2))])
        elif coords.shape[1] == 2:
            coords = np.hstack([coords, np.zeros((coords.shape[0], 1))])
        elif coords.shape[1] == 3:
            coords = coords

    # -------------------------
    # edges
    # -------------------------
    edges = np.argwhere(np.triu(A) == 1)

    edge_x, edge_y, edge_z = [], [], []

    for i, j in edges:
        edge_x += [coords[i,0], coords[j,0], None]
        edge_y += [coords[i,1], coords[j,1], None]
        edge_z += [coords[i,2], coords[j,2], None]

    # -------------------------
    # plot
    # -------------------------
    fig = go.Figure()

    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter3d(
        x=edge_x,
        y=edge_y,
        z=edge_z,
        mode='lines'
    ))

    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter3d(
        x=coords[:,0],
        y=coords[:,1],
        z=coords[:,2],
        mode='markers+text',
        text=[str(i+1) for i in range(len(coords))]
    ))

    fig.show()
```

T = np.array([
    [0,1,1,1],
    [1,0,1,1],
    [1,1,0,1],
    [1,1,1,0]
])

eigvals, eigvecs = np.linalg.eigh(T)
print("Eigenvalues:")
print(np.round(eigvals, 4))
